event.description: Tie the twelfth-closest positional scalar groups
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,107 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 15 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0072, the eleventh positional union at 2,107 parameters and 99.04%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034. The closest current groups have representatives 250 and 38, values 0.0151338242 and 0.0151371248, differing by 3.301e-6; representative 250 belongs to the accepted 388/250 group. Hypothesis: unioning coordinate 38 into that group with a multiplicity-weighted mean preserves qualification and yields 2,106 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested merge because it is the current minimum-distortion positional union.
